def _sequence_to_key_events(
        self, sequence: str, alt: bool = False
    ) -> Iterable[events.Key]:
        """Map a sequence of code points on to a sequence of keys.

        Args:
            sequence: Sequence of code points.

        Returns:
            Keys
        """

        if (match := _re_kitty_key.fullmatch(sequence)) is not None:
            key_codepoints = match["key"].split(":")
            key_code = int(key_codepoints[0])
            shifted_code = (
                int(key_codepoints[1])
                if len(key_codepoints) > 1 and key_codepoints[1]
                else None
            )
            base_layout_code = (
                int(key_codepoints[2])
                if len(key_codepoints) > 2 and key_codepoints[2]
                else None
            )

            modifiers = _decode_modifiers(match["modifiers"])
            phase = _EVENT_PHASES.get(int(match["event_type"] or "1"), "press")
            associated_text = match["text"]
            try:
                text = (
                    "".join(
                        chr(int(codepoint)) for codepoint in associated_text.split(":")
                    )
                    if associated_text is not None
                    else None
                )
            except (ValueError, OverflowError):
                return

            # A key code of zero means this event only carries associated text.
            if key_code == 0 and text is not None:
                yield events.Key(
                    text,
                    text,
                    phase=phase,
                    modifiers=modifiers,
                    base_key=text,
                )
                return

@pytest.mark.parametrize("sequence", ["\x1b[65;2u", "\x1b[97:65;2u"])
def test_kitty_shift_only_printable_character(parser, sequence: str):
    [event] = parser.feed(sequence)

    assert event.key in {"A", "shift+a"}
    assert event.character == "A"
    assert event.modifiers == ("shift",)
    assert event.base_key == "a"
    assert event.shift


def test_kitty_non_shift_modified_printable_shortcut(parser):
    [event] = parser.feed("\x1b[65;4u")

    assert event.key == "alt+shift+a"
    assert event.character is None
    assert event.modifiers == ("alt", "shift")
    assert event.base_key == "a"


def test_kitty_associated_text_preserves_key_metadata(parser):
    [event] = parser.feed("\x1b[97:65:113;2:2;65u")

    assert event.key in {"A", "shift+a"}
    assert event.character == "A"
    assert event.phase == "repeat"
    assert event.modifiers == ("shift",)
    assert event.base_key == "a"
    assert event.shifted_key == "A"
    assert event.base_layout_key == "q"


def test_kitty_associated_text_only(parser):
    [event] = parser.feed("\x1b[0;1;233u")

    assert event.key == "é"
    assert event.character == "é"


def test_kitty_long_associated_text_only(parser):
    text = "associated text"
    encoded_text = ":".join(str(ord(character)) for character in text)
    [event] = parser.feed(f"\x1b[0;1;{encoded_text}u")

    assert event.key == text
    assert event.character == text
